name: sprite2d
title: 2D platformer
description: Gravity, jumping and solid ground. Sprite sheet, animation, screen-space movement. No 3D.
detail: Sprites are textured quads drawn straight in screen space, skipping the GTE entirely -- which is why 2D runs so comfortably on this hardware. A sprite marked "solid" in scene.json is ground, a platform or a wall; physics_step() does gravity, movement and collision in one call.
